concept.title: Night Heist on Obsidian Mesa
concept.logline: On ash-choked, epic Kelforge, you slip past the watchers to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ember Shrine.
concept.source_prompt: Obsidian Mesa. obsidian basalt scorched ash stealth Stealth infiltration
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Glassrock Post and becomes the one who brings the Ember Shrine back to life.

characters.name: Forgemaster Bram
characters.description: Waits in Glassrock Post and knows why the Ember Shrine fell silent.

characters.name: Tobin the Apprentice
characters.description: Follows you from Glassrock Post and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Magma Sentinel
characters.description: A magma sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Magma Sentinel 2
characters.description: A magma sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Vent Warden
characters.description: A vent warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Magma Sentinel 3
characters.description: A magma sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Hale the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Kelforge for anything shiny.

characters.name: Ash Beetle
characters.description: A harmless ash beetle that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Slip past the sentinels site by site
Plant the signal at the finale
hazards: Ash sweeping the exposed ground around the Ember Shrine
Lava vents that scorch anyone who lingers
Magma Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On ash-choked, epic Kelforge, you slip past the watchers to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ember Shrine.
Heavy sentinels guard every site and they hit hard. Keep your distance.
In the Glass Cave. Unseen, for now.
In the Fire Fern Grove. Unseen, for now.
In the Pumice Village. Unseen, for now.
In the Miners' Camp. Unseen, for now.
Spotted! Break line of sight and get clear.
Signal planted. You were never here.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Bram
nodes.text: So you've come to Glassrock Post at last. I am Forgemaster Bram. On ash-choked, epic Kelforge, you slip past the watchers to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ember Shrine.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Bram
nodes.text: Back again. Glassrock Post is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Bram
nodes.text: Go to Miners' Camp, then Pumice Village. Whatever still remembers Night Heist on Obsidian Mesa is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Bram
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Glassrock Post, Night Heist on Obsidian Mesa was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Grim, even then.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Bram
nodes.text: Miners' Camp: Miners' Camp: a camp on the way out from Glassrock Post.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Bram
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Night Heist on Obsidian Mesa back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Bram
nodes.text: Pumice Village: Pumice Village: a village on the way out from Glassrock Post.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Apprentice
nodes.text: Tobin the Apprentice circles your feet, then looks toward Miners' Camp as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Apprentice
nodes.text: Tobin the Apprentice hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Apprentice
nodes.text: It turns toward Miners' Camp. Miners' Camp: a camp on the way out from Glassrock Post.

nodes.speaker: Magma Sentinel
nodes.text: Halt. Magma Sentinel, of the watch at Glassrock Post. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Magma Sentinel
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Magma Sentinel
nodes.text: Ash sweeping the exposed ground around the Ember Shrine. Worst near Miners' Camp.

nodes.text: Halt. Magma Sentinel 2, of the watch at Glassrock Post. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Magma Sentinel 2

nodes.speaker: Magma Sentinel 3
nodes.text: Ash sweeping the exposed ground around the Ember Shrine. Worst near Miners' Camp.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Glassrock Post. Hale the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Night Heist on Obsidian Mesa that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Miners' Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Ash Beetle
nodes.text: The ash beetle freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
